## The five attributes

1. Goal-driven
2. Multi-pass
3. Self-correcting
4. Tool-using
5. Grounded

## The three architecture patterns

| Pattern | Best for | Failure mode |
|---|---|---|
| Single-pass VLM | Simple, well-formed docs | Tables, complex layout |
| Agentic loop | High-stakes extraction | Latency, cost-per-page |
| Hybrid CV + VLM | High volume, varied layouts | Engineering complexity |
